summary: Read a wall built from n rows of bricks, with n from 1 to 10000. Every brick has the same height, widths may differ, and each row adds up to the same total width. A row contains at most 10000 bricks, the brick counts of all rows add up to at most 2 * 10^4, and a single width runs from 1 to 2^31 - 1. Draw one straight line from the upper edge down to the lower edge, not flush with either outer side. A line that only meets a seam between bricks does not break that brick. Find the smallest number of bricks such a line must break, and write that number.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
